status: exploratory follow-up; frozen before computing blend outcomes
global_ability: mean simulation score over all available tasks within embodiment; no physical labels
inner_selection: mean validation-task loss on remaining physical tasks; candidate weights are fixed, so candidates have no inner-fit parameters
primary_objective: task-macro ranking error on observed real gaps >=0.10; predicted ties cost 0.5
secondary_objective: task-macro MAE; report separately, do not select winner using outer results
tie_break: within 1e-12 of best loss: smallest abs(w1-w0), then smallest mean weight, then w0
sensitivity: exclude target simulated task from global ability, including each inner validation target
intervals: 2000 paired task bootstrap replicates; descriptive and unstable with 4-5 tasks
